headline: Single-file EV drift racer with battery survival physics
text:
We built a drifting game in a single HTML file where your EV battery is your health bar.

Real weight-transfer physics + zero install. Beat my score on today's Daily Road:

https://kreeda.games/drift/index.html

#gamedev #indiedev #webdev
mediaSuggestion: A 5-second looping 60fps gameplay clip showing a tight Scandinavian flick drift around a bend, cutting to regen braking while passing a ghost car.
